name: golfromeo-zcode-toolbox
description: Personal ZCode plugin collection: per-plugin install and activate/deactivate via the Plugins page on any instance.

plugins.name: context-lens
plugins.description: Side-pane live viewer for the LLM context window: composition, full system prompt, all tool schemas (filter/paging/expand) and message bodies (role chips, search, expand-all, focus pin, newest-first). Composer chip with provider-exact usage %, cache hit and cumulative output.

plugins.name: token-speed
plugins.description: Composer chip with the live output tokens-per-second (streaming rate while generating, last rate when idle, ttft and totals in the tooltip), plus subagent tracking: per-call rate in the parent session's chip and a side-pane Subagents view with live rates, totals and status. Independently activatable.

plugins.name: copilot-gateway
plugins.description: Runs the crispy-copilot-gateway (GitHub Copilot API gateway) locally for any harness: clones the gateway from GitHub into the plugin data dir and installs it (venv + pip) on first start; gateway_update keeps the git tree current. Isolated plugin-owned store; composer chip (up/latency, credits + accounts), side-pane view (accounts, device-flow login, proxy keys + pinning, credits metering, provider config) and MCP tools. Needs git + python>=3.12.
